findings.evidenceJa: 時間が経てば経つほど不利になる
findings.governingReading: the more time passes, the more disadvantageous the situation becomes
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a second-by-second rate and replaces tactical disadvantage with generic worsening.

findings.highlight: before all those worms can crawl at my body
findings.evidenceJa: 壁という壁に敷き詰められた虫が、そのまま床を埋め尽くして俺の体に這い上がってくる前に
findings.governingReading: before the insects covering every wall fill the floor and crawl up his body
findings.explanation: The swarm’s movement from walls across the floor and then onto Shirou is collapsed.

findings.evidenceJa: 老魔術師を斬り伏せる
findings.governingReading: he will cut the old magus down
findings.explanation: A concrete sword-like strike with the keisaku becomes generic victory.

findings.governingReading: the cut meets no resistance or tactile response
findings.explanation: The eerie ease of bisecting Zouken is reversed into a judgment that the attack is ineffective.

findings.highlight: A diagonal slash cuts the old magus
findings.evidenceJa: トマトのように容易く両断され
findings.governingReading: the mass is bisected as easily as a tomato
findings.explanation: The grotesque comparison explaining the cut’s lack of resistance disappears.

findings.highlight: Scraps of flesh scatter across the temple
findings.governingReading: the bisected mass falls to the hall floor
findings.explanation: The mature variant invents scattered scraps of flesh across the temple.

findings.governingReading: a fallen piece of the old magus
findings.explanation: The mature branch identifies the speaking fragment as Zouken’s head.

findings.evidenceJa: 警策が音を立てて崩れていく
findings.governingReading: the keisaku crumbles audibly
findings.explanation: Both the specific temple implement and its crumbling sound disappear.

findings.governingReading: crumbles apart
findings.explanation: mirror moon specifies reduction to dust.

findings.governingReading: that monstrous old man
findings.explanation: Shirou’s angry supernatural epithet for Zouken disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ブチブチと虫を踏み潰しながら
findings.governingReading: running while crushing insects underfoot with repeated wet snaps
findings.explanation: The audible violence and completed crushing action are reduced to stepping.

findings.highlight: Death follows close on my heels
findings.evidenceJa: 背中に圧し掛かる死の気配
findings.governingReading: the presence of death presses down on his back
findings.explanation: A crushing sensed presence becomes a conventional pursuit idiom.

findings.governingReading: he shoulder-charges the black wall leading outside the hall
findings.explanation: The destination that makes the charge an escape route disappears.

findings.highlight: the other side of the compound
findings.governingReading: a place opposite the temple precinct or courtyard
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns a relation to the precinct into the far side of the whole compound.

findings.evidenceJa: 建物から落ちた時に打ったのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps he struck himself when he fell from the building
findings.explanation: A concrete suspected impact during the fall is trivialized as an awkward landing.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの下に行かないと
findings.governingReading: he must reach Saber’s side
findings.explanation: The urgent movement to Saber becomes a search for her location.

findings.governingReading: a dull pain
findings.explanation: The quality of pain is reversed.

findings.highlight: My feet are missing from the heels down
findings.governingReading: both feet are—, like shoes slipping off when he jumped
findings.explanation: The mature branch explicitly completes the interrupted visual reveal as total bilateral foot loss.

findings.governingReading: while sprawled prone, he tries to pull himself out
findings.explanation: The helpless starting posture of Shirou’s arm-only escape attempt disappears.

findings.governingReading: his actual strength or ability could not support the correct judgment
findings.explanation: A broad lack of capability becomes a technical skill deficit.

findings.highlight: spiders have dwelt in the damp places of the earth
findings.governingReading: spiders have inhabited moisture since ancient times
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds earthly places and turns the gnomic association with moisture into habitat description.

findings.highlight: Hundreds of poisons that bite on my skin, crawl in my flesh, and melt my bones
findings.evidenceJa: 皮膚に食らいつき、肉に潜り込み、骨を溶かしていく何百もの毒
findings.governingReading: hundreds of poisonous agents bite into skin, burrow into flesh, and dissolve bone
findings.explanation: mirror moon produces a sentence fragment and weakens biting into and burrowing through tissue.

findings.evidenceJa: 地獄以上の苦痛と悪寒
findings.governingReading: pain worse than hell together with violent chills
findings.explanation: The explicit hell comparison and the chills are replaced by generic unimaginability.
